quote: Kobon Fujimura asked for the largest number N(n) of nonoverlapping triangles that can be constructed using n lines (Fujimura 1978; Gardner 1983, p. 170)
note: Problem appeared in Fujimura's book "The Tokyo Puzzles" published in 1978. Martin Gardner subsequently popularized it in 1983.
